paragraphs: Fleet Complete sells GPS fleet tracking and telematics to organizations that run vehicles. Customers range from small and mid-sized businesses to large corporations. In October 2024 the business was acquired by Powerfleet. The company says existing customer contracts, services and integrations stay unchanged through the brand change.

Trackers in each vehicle send location data by satellite to cloud software. From there staff can build reports on idling time, fuel consumption, utilization and unsafe driving. Dash cameras apply machine learning to flag distracted driving, speeding, tailgating, rolling stops and harsh braking. Driver apps handle compliance, including hours of service under FMCSA and Transport Canada certified ELD rules. Drivers can also file pre-trip or post-trip inspection reports from a mobile device.

One customer story recounts a school district police chief seeing where a cruiser was and dispatching help. The company claims more than 20 years of experience supporting fleet managers globally. Its acquirer says it works with over 50% of Fortune 500 companies.

quote.text: While the brand name is evolving, existing customer contracts, services, and integrations remain unchanged.
